0.0: Okay, I found it! It seems like the reason the tree has turned red is because the protective force that covers the forest, the barrier of the forest, might have been weakened. I don't know what caused this, but right now, we need the spell that temporarily strengthens the protective force that surrounds Minar Forest. I'm sorry, but you may need to help me out here.
0.1: Please deliver this letter to #bChief Tatamo#k. Oh, and make sure you bring #b5#k #b#t4000232#s, #t4000233#s, and #t4000234#s#k, which can only be obtained in Minar Forest. We'll need them to reinforce the Barrier.
0.2: The method I've shown you is only a temporary solution. Please inform them that they must resolve the fundamental problem to reverse what has happened to the forest.\r\n#e#b(Accept the quest then move to Leafre.)#n

no.0: Sigh... who should I refer this to, then?

1.0: So what did Grendel the Really Old say? \r\n#L0# #bHe told me to give you these.#k
1.1: Here, let me take a look at it.

yes.0: Ahh... this is the vintage scroll from #p1032001# which is of most importance to the Halflingers at this moment. This is the scroll that contains the spell that strengthens the barrier of this forest. Thankfully, you've brought the necessary ingredients for this. Great work. This should be good for a little while, but I'll need to find out why the Barrier of the Forest is weakened.
yes.1: Anyway, thank you for your great work. The barrier of the forest seems to have weakened quite a bit, so I advise you to stay alert against possible monster attacks in the forest.

npc.0: Please take this letter, along with #b5 #t4000232#s, 5 #t4000233#s, and 5 #t4000234#s#k to Tatamo.

item.0: Have you received an answer from #p1032001#?

lost.0: This is an important letter, one that I advise you not to lose ever again. Tatamo should be waiting for this right now.
